title: Sharp maps glue over special cofibrant colimit diagrams
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, weak equivalences and monomorphisms of [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper], and sharp maps and homotopy-cartesian squares as explicitly defined in [lem-coef-sharp-pullback-calculus]. Let $I$ be a small category and $p:U\to V$ a natural transformation of $I$-diagrams of simplicial sets. Assume each $p_i:U_i\to V_i$ is sharp and each naturality square for an arrow of $I$ is homotopy cartesian. Suppose one of the following holds:
(1) $I=\mathbf N$ with its usual order, and every successive map in each of $U,V$ is a monomorphism.
(2) $I$ is the span $1\leftarrow0\to2$, and the maps $U_0\to U_2$ and $V_0\to V_2$ are monomorphisms.
(3) $I=\mathcal P_{<}(S)$ is the inclusion poset of all proper subsets of a finite set $S$, including the empty subset when it is proper; both diagrams are cofibrant in the explicit sense that, for each proper $T\subset S$, the canonical map $\operatorname{colim}_{R\subsetneq T}U_R\to U_T$ is a monomorphism, and likewise for $V$.
Then $\operatorname{colim}_I U\to\operatorname{colim}_I V$ is sharp, and for every $i\in I$ the canonical square $U_i\to\operatorname{colim}_I U$ over $V_i\to\operatorname{colim}_I V$ is homotopy cartesian. No Kan or Reedy fibrancy is assumed. The empty indexing category in (3), when $S=\varnothing$, is included.
Moreover, let $e:E\to H$ be any sharp map, and let $U_i\to E$ and $V_i\to H$ be compatible cocones commuting with $p$ and $e$. If every component cocone square $U_i\to E$ over $V_i\to H$ is homotopy cartesian, then the induced square $\operatorname{colim}_I U\to E$ over $\operatorname{colim}_I V\to H$ is homotopy cartesian.
